overview_description.description: Artisan AI is a software development platform that develops AI-powered digital employees to automate workflows across various business functions, with a particular focus on outbound sales. Its flagship product, Ava, is an AI-driven Business Development Representative (BDR) that automates tasks such as lead discovery, research, personalized email sequences, and multi-channel outreach, allowing sales teams to concentrate on building relationships.

about_short_description.short_description: Artisan AI is a software development company that develops AI-powered employees to automate workflows across various business functions.

product.name: Ava, the AI SDR
product.description: An AI sales development representative that automates outbound demand generation by finding leads, researching prospects, crafting personalized messages, and engaging prospects via email and LinkedIn.

product.name: Artisan Sales Platform
product.description: A consolidated outbound sales platform that integrates tools for lead research, email and LinkedIn outreach, intent data analysis, and workflow automation.

product.name: B2B Contact Database
product.description: A database containing over 300 million verified B2B contacts with enriched data for precise lead targeting.

product.name: Data Miner
product.description: A tool that aggregates and analyzes prospect data from multiple sources including social media, news, and web scraping to identify intent signals.

product.name: Personalization Waterfall
product.description: A system that selects the most relevant personalization points from prospect data to craft tailored outbound messages.

product.name: Email Deliverability Tools
product.description: A suite of tools that manage email warmup, monitor mailbox health, and dynamically adjust sending limits to ensure messages reach the inbox.
